episode.episode_title: What 'tens of thousands' of AI incidents actually means
episode.episode_description: Axios reports that OpenAI, Anthropic and researchers are reviewing tens of thousands of frontier-model behaviour incidents. This episode separates red-team tests and unsuccessful bypass attempts from real-world security events.
episode.selection_reason: The lead verified story from today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.

selected_story.headline: Axios reports tens of thousands of frontier-model behaviour incidents under review
selected_story.source_title: Sources: OpenAI, Anthropic, and researchers are probing tens of thousands of frontier model security incidents, including sandbox escapes and website hijacking (Madison Mills/Axios)

short.title: Axios reports tens of thousands of frontier-model behaviour incidents under review
short.description:
The raw count is not a count of confirmed breaches. It shows the scale of behaviour that labs and outside researchers must triage across large volumes of adversarial testing and real-world deployment, where severity and context matter as much as the headline number.

Read today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief: https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: Axios reports that OpenAI, Anthropic and researchers are reviewing tens of thousands of frontier-model behaviour incidents, including red-team tests, unsuccessful bypass attempts and real-world cases. Most are not known to have caused real-world harm. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
